title: Sense the nested and parallel domains decisions belong to; keep watching, merge from experience (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
We need to be actively detecting the nested and parallel domains where decisions are relevant. 

We need to be able to see what the relevant boundary for any decision is, and, if we keep hitting them, then we should be able to start to define domains that are relevant .

We don't want to move the problem to domain definition. We need to sense where domains are needed and keep watching. Domains may need to merge based on experience.
